verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.adyen.com that returns HTTP 200 and describes Adyen's developer and merchant documentation. Another probe confirms the Agentic Commerce pages are served as clean Markdown (.md) with frontmatter, and the whole agent-platform and merchant doc set is reachable at .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-friendly docs. Missing for 10: confirmation that the llms.txt index specifically lists the Agentic Commerce section, and independent or community reports of agents using these docs in practice.
